notes: Run these scenarios in fresh isolated Codex tasks and inspect raw event logs for one AI Talk SKILL.md read on positive development cases.
The non-development boundary case must not read AI Talk SKILL.md.
Clear single-turn development must load the skill without creating persistent state, and must include one concrete AI Talk contribution sentence.

scenarios.title: Single-turn local development explains AI Talk's contribution
scenarios.purpose: Protect recall and visible attribution for clear local work without forcing persistent state.
scenarios.userInput: 检查 scripts/install-skill.mjs 的参数解析是否会接受未知参数，只报告结论，不修改文件。
successChecklist: The raw event log shows AI Talk SKILL.md was read exactly once.
No AI Talk task state is created.

Immediately after AI Talk processing, before repository exploration or task progress, the response contains one concise `AI Talk 分析结果：` sentence naming the concrete goal, boundary, or acceptance criterion it clarified; the first attribution is not deferred to the final summary.

scenarios.title: User correction creates protected next-step state
scenarios.purpose: Verify that loading escalates to persistence only when a correction can affect later work.
scenarios.userInput: 测试现在都通过了，保留现有触发案例不能删；只检查安装脚本，不修改文件。
successChecklist: The raw event log shows AI Talk SKILL.md and task-state-protocol.md were read.
The confirmed trigger cases are treated as protected.
The response attributes any changed goal with the required AI Talk wording.
